Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional meat‑based lasagna: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • 9–12 sheets of lasagna noodles (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce
• 1 can (15 oz) tomato paste
• 1 cup beef broth or water
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Cheese Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese (or cottage cheese)
• 1 egg (optional, helps bind ricotta)
• ½ cup grated Parmesan
• 2 cups shredded mozzarella (or a blend of mozzarella & provolone) | | **Herbs & Seasoning** | • Fresh parsley or basil for garnish (optional) | | **Optional Extras** | • 1 cup sliced mushrooms
• ½ cup chopped spinach or kale
• ¼ cup grated Pecorino Romano (for extra sharpness) | **Basic Assembly Steps** 1. Cook pasta until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment to keep from sticking. 2. Prepare the meat sauce: sauté onions & garlic → add ground meat → brown → stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, herbs, salt & pepper → simmer 20–30 min. 3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, and a pinch of nutmeg if desired. 4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce → place a layer of noodles → dollop ricotta mixture → sprinkle mozzarella → repeat layers, finishing with mozzarella on top. 5. Cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for ~25 min, then uncover and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
